capability.description: Find local Skills, Tools, and MCP capabilities for the current conversation and return selected refs; no arguments. Read provided Skill entry paths directly; use capability to discover other Skills. Do not search the filesystem or web for Skills. Use read to inspect the Skill entry paths.
guidelines: Understand the task and project context first, then check whether you lack guidance, background info, or specialized tools (e.g. for tasks like PPT creation or complex workflows). If true, call capability; otherwise proceed directly.
Skills provide workflows, rules, and conventions. Read provided Skill entry paths directly; discover other Skills through capability (not filesystem or web searches).

Reuse discovered capabilities throughout the task; use capability whenever current tools do not cover the needs, or if you lose track of a Skill's path. For existing tools and MCP, use describeTool(name) in codemode to inspect parameters, or ALL_TOOLS to list what you have (filtering recommended).

step.label: Capability Step
step.description: Advance discovery by searching with queries, accumulating selected refs, or finishing. All parameters optional.

parameters.queries: Parallel local keyword searches in English. Focus each query on one capability need, using concise action, object, and distinguishing terms. Preserve product/API names. Defaults to []; omit when not searching.
parameters.refs: Exact refs from earlier results. Select namespace refs, not member refs. Selections accumulate; defaults to [].
parameters.finish: Set true to finish discovery. Defaults to false.
